runtimeKernelsNote: kernel_selection_contract_v1 registry, mirroring the existing precedent in apple_a17pro_mobile.json (Metal RMSNorm f32). Deliberately small and honest: exactly ONE dispatchable kernel is declared for this target -- a portable scalar C++ fused MatMul+Bias+ReLU kernel reusing the bm32_bn32_bk32 tile candidate identity from the CPU fused-schedule-discovery work (Phase 1 / R1, see apps/run_cpu_fused_schedule_discovery.cpp), reimplemented as new native code in the sibling heterogeneous-inference-runtime repo rather than shared source across repos (portfolio repo-independence). Every other op on this target remains rejected or deferred with an explicit reason -- this is a kernel-selection framework, not broad coverage. Architectural note: kernel_selection_contract_v1 matches on (op_name, backend, dtype, quant_mode, layout, tile-plan, local-memory) but has no native mechanism to gate on concrete (M,N,K) shape values or tensor rank; that finer-grained shape/rank/layout validation is intentionally enforced by the runtime adapter at dispatch time (see heterogeneous-inference-runtime), not by this static declaration -- documented here rather than silently assumed or left for the runtime to discover. ml-platform-capabilities is not consulted by this declaration (existing architectural bypass predating this PR, unchanged here).
